test: live backend-owner crash and session takeover
environment: isolated local Docker Compose project; PostgreSQL 16; two backend processes; TLS Nginx proxy; loopback ports; temporary synthetic users and lesson
scope_and_limits: The previous owner container was killed, then restarted by the smoke script. REST needed five client attempts while Nginx workers converged after initial 502 responses; all four WebSocket channels connected on the first post-takeover attempt. This did not simulate a live network partition of the old process, did not replay the full DDS action flow, and did not test target 6-core/32-GB hardware or 20 sessions/100 users during failover. Test users, session, and audit rows were removed by the script. Repeat using scripts/test_cluster_failover.py.
